name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.72 / build 73 packages the mobile staff-chat Back / End conversation toolbar and divider, Continue / End choice and Help Bot feedback flow. Continue keeps the conversation and unsent draft. End asks Was our staff helpful?; Like or Dislike explicitly saves its rating and ends the cycle before returning to the main menu. Failed feedback saves remain retryable and duplicate taps are blocked. Existing encrypted patient-scoped Help Bot history, server-saved staff conversations, later continuation, one-second opening and scrolling typing indicators are retained. The website has the matching chat flow. No backend, desktop, database, Firebase, SDK or signing-key deployment is included. Existing development certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation, recovery and push delivery are not verified.
